# clavis admin unseal

<p class="cli-lead">Reconstruct the root key from Shamir shares</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin unseal [flags]
```

</div>

Rebuild the root key from enough shares, verify it, and let the server start again.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin unseal --share share-01.key --share share-03.key --share share-05.key
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-config"><dt><code>--config string</code></dt><dd>configuration file</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-force"><dt><code>--force</code></dt><dd>overwrite an existing root key file</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-share"><dt><code>--share stringArray</code></dt><dd>share file (repeat for each share)</dd></div>
</dl>

## Details

Needs `keys.provider=file`.
